role: Index of the five white papers in docs/whitepapers with their PDFs, the source revision/scoring version they describe, and version history.

units.does: Index of five papers: papers 1 to 4 (v1.4) describe Emuqu at 6b195c6 (2026-11-21), scoring version v3.3.nov2026 (matches ScoringVersion.current); paper 5 the design method; code is authoritative where they disagree. Lists each paper's .md and .pdf (all ten files exist in docs/whitepapers/) and points to Tools/validation/ (exists) for the cross-implementation scripts. Version history: v1.0-v1.3 (v1.1 of paper 5) published 2026-10-08; v1.4 of papers 1 to 4 published 2026-11-22 (matches the paper headers).
